question: I am switching from another insurer. Will my 3 years of waiting period carry over if I increase my sum insured?
answer: Waiting periods already served with a previous insurer will carry over, but only up to the sum insured of your previous policy, including any accrued no-claim bonus [1][2]. Any increase or excess in the sum insured will be subject to fresh waiting periods on that incremental amount [1][2].
